content: focus-trap-react is a narrow utility (keyboard focus containment only) typically combined with other manual a11y work (ARIA labeling, Escape handling, inert background) for custom (non-native) modals. Radix UI Dialog is a fuller headless primitive (focus trap + Escape + labeling + portal) but is a real dependency addition. Native <dialog> covers what both provide for a single simple modal without adding either dependency.
